newsitem.title: USA: MiniMed expects Q3 shr $0.09 to $0.10.
newsitem.headline: MiniMed expects Q3 shr $0.09 to $0.10.

text.p: MiniMed Inc said Monday it expects to report third quarter earnings of between $0.09 and $0.10 per share on revenues of about $14.5 million.
Net income for the quarter is expected to range from $1.1 million to $1.2 million, the company said.
In last year's third quarter, the company posted earnings of $0.06 per share.

MiniMed attributed the increased earnings to greater acceptance by the marketplace of its products in the intensive management of diabetes, particularly its Model 507 insulin infusion pump, which was introduced in June.
The company plans to release its third quarter results by October 16.
